FAQ

Have questions? We have answers.

With the Synchrony HOME credit card you can take advantage of many card benefits including:

  • Acceptance at all Synchrony HOME partners: The Synchrony HOME credit card can be used at thousands of Synchrony HOME partner retailers nationwide. Visit the store locator to find locations near you.
  • Select Synchrony HOME partners may offer longer term promotional financing offers ranging from 12 to 60 months on qualifying purchases.Footnote1
  • Enjoy everyday promotional financing on qualifying purchases anywhere the card is accepted. Get 6 months on purchases of $299 - $1998.99 or 12 months on purchases of $1,999 or more.Footnote2
  • No Annual Fee.Footnote3
  • Safe & Secure with $0 Fraud Liability
  • Free Access to your credit score
  • Ability to request a credit limit increaseFootnote4
  • 24/7 secure online account access with customizable account alerts
  • Manage your account easily on the go with the MySynchrony Mobile AppFootnote5(Available on iOS and Android)

 

The Synchrony HOME credit card is accepted at all Synchrony HOME Partner locations. We have partners in home categories including furniture, mattresses, electronics & appliances and more. To find Synchrony HOME Partners, check out Synchrony HOME retailers or visit our store locator to find locations near you.

For Synchrony HOME Partners that accept the card online look for the option to pay with a Synchrony HOME credit card on the payment page. Enter your Synchrony HOME credit card account number when prompted.

You will only be charged interest on your promotional balance if you do not pay it off within the promotional period.

The promotional summary box on your monthly statement will clearly show the balance for each promotional financing purchase and corresponding expiration date. You can always choose to pay off your promotional balance earlier as well.

  1. Register for your account online.
  2. Or take a step further and download the MySynchrony mobile appFootnote3 (available in the Apple app store on iOS and Google Play for Android) to have your statements at your fingertips. Our app also has special offers from Synchrony HOME Partners and a store locator so you can find Synchrony HOME Partner locations near you, on the go!

Synchrony HOME™ cardholders can manage their account online by registering / signing in or Chat with us (chat is unavailable in Internet Explorer) if you need additional account assistance.

You may call 1-844-335-5909 to speak to a customer service representative.
